title: Everything is free mall store
content: I have a reoccurring dream of being trapped in some sort of shopping center, not sure if it’s a mall or just a really big store. But in this dream I get to pick out items I desire most (make up, clothes, video games, animals, strange objects, etc.) and once I reach the last item I always seem to wake up. Not sure if this is just a dream in my own world or if this is a part of the mall world. Anyone have similar dreams??..
